study.question: Does explicitly exposing the latest target-matching field/action event add predictive information beyond match count and summed decay, and does any gain depend on matching the event age to target identity rather than generic recent activity?
study.hypothesis: The incumbent explicit evidence compresses each field/action match population to count and total exponentially decayed mass. This map loses temporal extremes. For example, target-matching decay values (.2,.8) and (.4,.6) have count 2 and sum 1 but different maxima. Keeping the union of four ages fixed also keeps overall support and decay fixed. Learned pooled embeddings may already recover this distinction, so the hypothesis concerns incremental predictive utility of an explicit latest-event readout, not information absence from the whole network. Recent target-matching behavior may indicate reactivated interest distinct from average age or count. This remains an untested mechanism hypothesis, not a demonstrated recency failure.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit the local normalized DIN-style retrieval, not an exact DIN reproduction; primary DIN abandons softmax normalization. Add deterministic per-field/action latest-event features, without new attention layers.

nearest_work.source_ref: https://arxiv.org/html/2308.08487v4, Temporal Interest Network, July 3 2024, sec 3.1.1-3.1.2, equations 2, lines 123-150; read through web during this proposal
nearest_work.difference: TIN combines target-relative temporal encoding, target attention and target-aware representation. This experiment adds eight deterministic extreme/mean recency features to the frozen parent; it does not implement TIN or assert novelty.

README confirms category/brand/action histories without item identity. Publisher paper is unavailable here; no detailed DMR mechanism claim. We use only supplied field IDs, action types and causal ages.

Prior branch learned eight horizon or amplitude scalars for SUMMED match decay. New branch keeps parent fixed decay and adds an order statistic (maximum decay), with target-versus-activity and maximum-versus-mean controls. Global priority is unverified; no novelty claim.

inherited_components: Existing 16-dimensional field/action/recency embeddings and shared DIN-style scorer
Blind static context residual query gain .5 and shared aligned field retrieval
Original 16 count/decay-match and 8 pair-valid support features
Host information boundary, optimizer, BCE objective, training recipe, sample coverage, scorer and validation-only selection

Trajectory review: static .605004 -> pooled .610226 -> DIN .613362; match-count r0000 .616754 and aligned-time r0001 .617149 improved provisionally. Pair joint r0002 .618352 did not beat support .618457; action-attention r0003 .617934 lost; separate routing r0004 .618502 did not beat shared .618521; adaptive query r0005 .618560 did not beat blind .618603. Availability gating r0006 .618283, interaction readout r0007 aligned product .617908, magnitude r0008 best .618501, and temporal kernels r0009 best .618499 all failed to exceed incumbent. All are seed-42 exploratory trajectories, not independent mechanism confirmations; failures and abandoned hypotheses remain in immutable receipts.
study.proposed_difference: For each of two fields and four actions compute N_match, N_valid, match decay mean M_match/N_match, overall valid decay mean M_valid/N_valid, match maximum decay and valid maximum decay. The four cells append eight features: match/latest = max decay over matching events; activity/latest = 1[N_match>0]*max decay over valid events; match/mean = mean matching decay; activity/mean = 1[N_match>0]*mean valid decay. Zero for absent matches, missing target fields and empty histories in all cells. All summaries use supplied causal ages and are permutation invariant, so no unverified event ordering is assumed. Original 24 evidence coordinates and pooled representation are unchanged. Build parent network first, append eight zero columns to first classifier weight without RNG draws, then append features in forward; exact inherited initial weights and biases are preserved. All cells compute all four summaries before selecting eight coordinates. This is an explicit extremal-statistic intervention; it is not a larger horizon sweep or evidence for any full external system.
predictions: Primary predeclared performance contrast: match_latest minus activity_latest on full-population validation AUC. Positive paired-seed effects would support useful exact target-age binding at the extreme, subject to controls.

Extremal increment: match_latest should exceed match_mean; factorial interaction (match_latest-activity_latest)-(match_mean-activity_mean) should be positive if target-specific extremes matter beyond target-specific average recency.
match_mean is recoverable from the inherited sufficient counts/masses; improvement shared with match_mean suggests easier readout/extra capacity or optimization rather than newly exposed extremes.

All variants have expected 17134371 total / 17078688 embedding / 55683 dense parameters. Added features lie in [0,1]. Zero absent-match and empty-history values, latest>=mean per population, and activity_latest>=match_latest are structural predictions.

Host-provided existing history-length, action-presence, category-match and frequency slices are secondary exploratory diagnostics. Report counts and do not invent unavailable full-population latest-age slices. Candidate measurements are first 512 impressions only and descriptive.
falsifiers: match_latest fails to exceed both activity_latest and match_mean across paired seeds: no supported useful target-specific extreme mechanism, even if one cell beats incumbent.
Zero/nonpositive factorial interaction defeats the claim that target binding helps latest-event recency more than average recency; latest and mean effects can remain separately uncertain.
A candidate beats the historical incumbent but not same-capacity controls: improvement cannot be attributed to latest target matching.
No match/latest versus mean feature or counterfactual logit separation in the fixed 512-impression diagnostic: intended pathway may be inactive or data too sparse; inspect before interpreting a null.

Nonfinite logits/diagnostics, missing-ID matches, padded-event influence, nonzero empty summaries or altered inherited features invalidate implementation; charged failure is not scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: Generic activity recency drives apparent gains; activity_latest controls this while retaining match existence.
Added first-layer parameters or an easier nonlinear ratio readout rather than new information; all four capacity-matched cells and match_mean control this incompletely.
Attentive pooling already captures latest-match information, making deterministic features redundant.
Very sparse non-pv matches limit usefulness: latest r0009 diagnostics on first 512 show category buy matches mean 0 and brand buy .015625; these are not population estimates.
Truncation to most recent 128 events censors older matches; results concern only supplied histories and benchmark static snapshots of undocumented as-of date.
Random seed, fixed three-epoch optimization, checkpoint selection and repeated validation search may explain small differences; seed 42 alone is not repeated support.
